blips.list: The blips staff put on the game's own map. Every player sees them on the map and the radar, and they stay after a server restart.
blips.count: How many blips there are now, and the most allowed. When it is full, delete a blip to add another.
blips.search: Filters the list by name or icon name. Changes nothing in the game.

add.text: Opens an empty form for a new blip. Nothing shows on the map until you save it.
add.example: Valentine storehouse, the store icon, green

blips.edit: Opens this blip in the form. Players see the old blip until you save.

delete.text: Removes this blip from every player's map. A second step asks you to confirm first.
delete.undo: No. Add it again with Add blip

blips.teleport: Moves you to this blip's position. Needs the teleport permission, and closes the console.

name.text: The name players see when they point at the blip on the map. At most 48 letters.

sprite.text: The blip's icon, one of the game's own. Type part of its name to search.

blips.color: A colour added to the blip, from the game's colours. The swatches here are close, the real look shows on the game's map.
blips.scale: The blip's size on the map. 1 is the normal size, less is smaller.

position.text: Where the blip is, as X and Y, with Z optional. Paste a vector3 or use the buttons.

blips.here: Puts where you stand now in the position boxes. Nothing is saved until you press save.
blips.waypoint: Puts the waypoint you set on the game's map in the position boxes.
blips.preview: The blip's icon, colour and size, close to how the map shows it.
blips.save: Saves the blip; it shows on every player's map within a second.
blips.cancel: Closes the form without saving. If you changed something it asks first.

confirmDelete.text: Press Delete blip to remove it from everyone's map now. Cancel keeps it as it is.
confirmDelete.undo: No, you must add it again

blips.discard: You have changes that are not saved. Confirming drops them and closes the form.
blips.loadFailed: The blips could not be read from the server. Try again in a moment.
blips.retry: Asks the server for the blips again.
blips.saveFailed: The blip was not saved. The reason is written here; fix it and save again.

blips.lead: Every player sees them on the game's own map and on the radar.
blips.empty: No blips yet. Add the first one.
blips.name: Name
blips.saved: Blip saved; every player sees it now
blips.needLonger: The name is longer than 48 letters
blips.needPos: Write X and Y, or use Where I am
blips.deleteText: This blip disappears from every player's map at once.
blips.discardText: Your changes to this blip are not saved. If you leave them they are lost.
blips.loadFailed: The blips could not be loaded
blips.full: The limit of %s blips is reached.

need.name: the name
need.pos: the place (here or the map waypoint)
